sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS CNTRL APPALACHIANS...MID ATLANTIC INTO SRN NY...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A RELATIVELY STAGNANT UPPER PATTERN WILL EXIST...WITH A BROAD TROUGH IN THE WEST AND A HUDSON BAY TROUGH. GENERALLY WEAK UPPER FORCING WILL EXIST BETWEEN THE TWO FEATURES...WITH CONVECTION PRIMARILY BECOMING FOCUSED ALONG A FRONT EXTENDING FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS EWD...AND ALONG THE DRYLINE FOR THE SRN PLAINS.

sections.title: CNTRL/NRN PLAINS SEWD INTO THE MID MS AND OH VALLEYS
sections.text: DEEP LAYER FLOW WILL STRENGTHEN IN ADVANCE OF A PERSISTENT WRN TROUGH...THOUGH FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL ONCE AGAIN REMAIN SUBTLE FOR THE PLAINS EWD. DIURNAL HEATING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO AN EROSION OF WEAK CONVECTIVE INHIBITION BY AFTERNOON...THOUGH SHORT WAVE RIDGING MAY INITIALLY SUPPRESS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT UNTIL THE NEXT UPPER DISTURBANCE APPROACHES. THE PRIMARY DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO BE FOCUSED ALONG A STATIONARY FRONT...LOCATED ROUGHLY NEAR THE CNTRL/ERN SD/NEB BORDER BY LATE AFTERNOON. ASSOCIATED SURFACE CONVERGENCE MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO OVERCOME ANY WEAK SUBSIDENCE LEFT IN THE WAKE OF THE EXITING SHORT WAVE TROUGH. WITH THE EXPECTED INCREASE IN DEEP LAYER SHEAR...LINGERING STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MOISTURE...A GREATER PROBABILITY OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF SIGNIFICANT HAIL...DMGG WINDS...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO APPEAR POSSIBLE NEAR THE AFOREMENTIONED FRONT. STORMS WILL LIKELY DEVELOP ACROSS S CNTRL/SERN SD AND N CNTRL/NERN NEB INITIALLY...THEN EXPAND EWD INTO SRN MN/NRN IA WITH TIME. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY BE POSSIBLE TO THE EAST ALONG SEVERAL REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND A SWD SAGGING COLD FRONT...THOUGH SURFACE CONVERGENCE/LOW LEVEL FOCUS WILL GENERAL

sections.title: PORTIONS OF THE SRN PLAINS
sections.text: COVERAGE OF STORMS REMAINS QUESTIONABLE FRI...WITH MODEL CONSENSUS GENERALLY SPLIT WITH REGARDS TO THE TIMING OF AN UPPER WAVE...LOCATED ACROSS ERN NM AS OF 03Z/FRI. FASTER PROGRESSION AS SUGGESTED BY SOME NEWER MODEL RUNS WOULD SUGGEST AT LEAST SHORT WAVE RIDGING/SUBSIDENCE IN ITS WAKE...POTENTIALLY LIMITING A GREATER COVERAGE OF STORMS. REGARDLESS...ALL FORECASTS SUGGEST CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL BE OVERCOME...WITH AT LEAST ISOLATED DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE DRYLINE. GIVEN THE EXTREME INSTABILITY AND MODEST DEEP LAYER FLOW...SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF SIGNIFICANT HAIL AND DMGG WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE.

sections.title: CNTRL APPALACHIANS...MID ATLANTIC INTO SRN NY
sections.text: LITTLE CHANGE IN THE ANTECEDENT AIR MASS IS ANTICIPATED...WITH SEASONABLY WARM SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND MOIST CONDITIONS CONTRIBUTING TO MODERATE INSTABILITY BY THE AFTERNOON. A LEADING SHORT WAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO SAG SWD ACROSS THE NORTHEAST...INITIATING NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS SRN NY AND PORTIONS OF THE UPPER MID ATLANTIC. PRIMARY INITIATION IS EXPECTED IN ASSOCIATION WITH A DEEPENING SURFACE TROUGH...EXTENDING SWD THROUGH QUEBEC INTO THE MID ATLANTIC. SEVERE DEVELOPMENT WILL LIKELY INCREASE IN CONJUNCTION WITH DIURNAL HEATING. FARTHER S...A PERSISTENT KY/TN UPPER WAVE WILL MEANDER EWD...INFLUENCING AN INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT OVER PORTIONS OF THE APPALACHIANS AND MID ATLANTIC REGION. DEEP LAYER FLOW WILL INCREASE SLIGHTLY ACROSS THE NORTHEAST...BUT REMAIN WEAK FARTHER S. AS SUCH...A MIXTURE OF SEMI-ORGANIZED CLUSTERS AND PULSE STORMS IS EXPECTED...WITH PRIMARY THREATS OF DMGG WIND AND LARGE HAIL. ..HURLBUT/GRAMS.. 05/04/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF THE SRN PLNS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... LARGE SCALE PATTERN ACROSS THE LWR 48 WILL BE DOMINATED BY BROAD...SLOWLY PROGRESSIVE TROUGH THAT WILL MOVE FROM THE PACIFIC NW TO NRN/CNTRL GRT BASIN BY 12Z SAT...AND MULTI-STREAM...LOW AMPLITUDE ANTICYCLONIC FLOW FROM THE PLNS TO THE E CST. MODEST DEEPENING OF THE WRN TROUGH WILL RESULT IN WEAK HEIGHT RISES ACROSS THE RCKYS AND N CNTRL STATES THROUGH THE PERIOD. FARTHER S...HOWEVER...A PERSISTENT AREA OF MODEST FALLS WILL PRECEDE A COMPLEX-LOOKING SRN STREAM DISTURBANCE NOW OVER THE SRN HI PLNS. WEAK HEIGHT FALLS ALSO WILL OCCUR OVER THE NORTHEAST AND MID ATLANTIC STATES AS A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE CROSSING QUE GRAZES THE REGION. FEATURES WILL REMAIN DIFFUSE AT THE SFC. A FRONTAL ZONE WILL REMAIN MORE OR LESS STNRY FROM MT/SD ESE THROUGH THE MID MS/MID OH VLYS. THE ERN EXTENSION OF THIS BOUNDARY...NOW OVER THE LWR GRT LKS...WILL ADVANCE SEWD AS COLD FRONT INTO THE MID ATLANTIC. THROUGH MUCH OF ITS EXTENT...HOWEVER...THE EFFECTIVE BOUNDARY/MAIN FOCUS OF LOW LVL UPLIFT WILL BE PROVIDED BY OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES LEFT FROM OVERNIGHT MCSS. ELSEWHERE...WRN OK/W TX DRY LINE WILL MIX SLIGHTLY E INTO ADJACENT PORTIONS OF OK AND TX LATER TODAY. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REM

sections.title: NRN/CNTRL PLNS SE TO THE MID MS VLY TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: EXISTING CLUSTERS OF SLIGHTLY ELEVATED STORMS OVER PARTS OF THE NRN PLNS AND MID MS VLY MAY WEAKEN FOR AWHILE TODAY BEFORE DIURNAL HEATING WILL WEAKEN EML CAP AND POSSIBLY SUPPORTS SOME REJUVENATION OF THIS ACTIVITY DURING THE AFTN. OTHERWISE... WEAK SHORT WAVE RIDGING DOWNSTREAM FROM WRN STATES TROUGH MAY INITIALLY DELAY OR SUPPRESS DIURNAL STORM DEVELOPMENT. AT ANY RATE...THE MAIN FOCUS FOR DEVELOPMENT SHOULD BE ALONG WNW-ESE ORIENTED STNRY FRONT NEAR THE SD/NEB BORDER BY MID-LATE AFTN. 30-40 KT DEEP WNWLY SHEAR...COUPLED WITH STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES AND INCREASING LOW LVL MOISTURE COULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DMGG WIND...AND PERHAPS A COUPLE TORNADOES. THE STORMS LIKELY WILL MOVE/DEVELOP E/SE ACROSS S CNTRL/SERN SD AND N CNTRL/NERN NEB...AND THEN EXPAND FARTHER E AND S INTO SRN MN/NRN IA WITH TIME. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY FARTHER SE ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES IN THE MID MS VLY...WHERE MODEST WNWLY FLOW AND MODERATE INSTABILITY WILL SUPPORT MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND OCCASIONAL SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND INTO TNGT.

sections.title: SRN PLNS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: POCKETS OF VERY STRONG SFC-BASED INSTABILITY /SBCAPE TO 5000 J PER KG/ MAY DEVELOP TODAY OVER PARTS OF TX AND OK ALONG AND E OF DRY LINE...WHERE RICH LOW LVL MOISTURE WILL PERSIST BENEATH 500 MB TEMPS AOB MINUS 12C. CLOUDS ASSOCIATED WITH WEAK DISTURBANCE PRECEDING MAIN AFOREMENTIONED SRN STREAM IMPULSE MAY MITIGATE DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION IN SOME AREAS...AND LOW LVL CONVERGENCE IS FORECAST TO REMAIN WEAK. THESE FACTORS MAY LIMIT OVERALL STORM COVERAGE. BUT ANY SUSTAINED STORMS THAT DO FORM WILL BE CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...DMGG WIND...AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO GIVEN DEGREE OF BUOYANCY AND LARGE SCALE ASCENT PROVIDED BY MAIN UPR IMPULSE.

sections.title: OH VLY INTO MID ATLANTIC/SRN NY THIS AFTN
sections.text: WITH LITTLE CHANGE IN THE OVERALL PATTERN SINCE YESTERDAY AND SEASONABLY WARM/MOIST LOW LVL ENVIRONMENT...DAYTIME HEATING SHOULD FOSTER SCTD AREAS OF STRONG TO SVR STORMS FROM PARTS OF IND AND OH INTO WRN/CNTRL PA AND SRN NY. ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED BY SRN FRINGE OF SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSING QUE. WHILE ACTIVITY MAY FIRST FOCUS ALONG AFOREMENTIONED COLD FRONT...STORMS ALSO MAY FORM A BIT LATER IN THE DAY NEAR LEE TROUGH IN ERN PA/MD...AND OVER KY...ON WRN FRINGE OF CLOUD DEBRIS FROM OVERNIGHT MCS IN WV. WIND PROFILES SUGGEST A MIXTURE OF SUSTAINED AND PULSE STORMS THAT LIKELY WILL MERGE INTO LOOSELY-ORGANIZED CLUSTERS...WITH THE MAIN SVR THREATS BEING DMGG WIND AND HAIL. ..CORFIDI/GARNER.. 05/04/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF OK/TX
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... MOST PROMINENT LARGE-SCALE FEATURE THIS PERIOD IS MIDLEVEL TROUGH WHICH WILL UNDERGO AMPLIFICATION WHILE PROGRESSING FROM THE PACIFIC NW INTO NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. THIS FEATURE WILL BE EMBEDDED WITHIN THE PRIMARY BELT OF WESTERLIES EXTENDING EWD ACROSS THE N-CNTRL STATES TO A DOWNSTREAM TROUGH MOVING SEWD THROUGH QUEBEC AND NEW ENGLAND. ELSEWHERE...A LOWER LATITUDE BELT OF HIGHER MOMENTUM FLOW WITH EMBEDDED VORTICITY MAXIMA --SOME OF CONVECTIVE ORIGIN-- WILL EXIST FROM THE SRN PLAINS THROUGH MID-MS AND OH VALLEYS TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST. AT THE SURFACE...MORNING ANALYSIS SHOWS PRIMARY SYNOPTIC FRONT EXTENDING FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES WWD THROUGH THE MID-MO VALLEY TO LOW PRESSURE OVER SWRN NEB...AND THEN NNWWD INTO ERN MT. THE ERN EXTENSION OF THIS BOUNDARY WILL ADVANCE EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE NERN STATES IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE ABOVE-MENTIONED SHORTWAVE TROUGH. LITTLE NET SWD DISPLACEMENT OF THE FRONT IS ANTICIPATED OVER THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS OWING TO FALLING HEIGHTS/PRESSURES ASSOCIATED WITH PRIMARY MIDLEVEL TROUGH MOVING INTO THE NRN ROCKIES. THIS SYNOPTIC FRONT AND PRE-EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES OVER THE OH AND MID-MS VALLEYS WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE F

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO MID-ATLANTIC COAST THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: MORNING VISIBLE SATELLITE AND RADAR DATA SHOW A SERIES OF CONVECTIVELY INDUCED VORTICITY MAXIMA PROGRESSING EWD ACROSS THE REGION. FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH THESE FEATURES...SEWD-PROGRESSING COLD FRONT...LEE TROUGH...AND PRE-EXISTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES WILL FOCUS AN INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT TODAY WITHIN AN MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MLCAPE OF 1000-2000+ J/KG. THE STRONGEST DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL EXIST ACROSS THE OH VALLEY WHERE ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELL AND/OR BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. FARTHER E...WEAKER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL MODULATE THE DEGREE OF STORM ORGANIZATION WITH MULTICELL AND PULSE STORM MODES WITH A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL.

sections.title: SRN PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: 12Z OUN/FWD SOUNDINGS SHOWED 8.0-9.0 C/KM 700-500-MB LAPSE RATES ATOP 100-MB LOWEST-MEAN MIXING RATIOS OF 14-15 G/KG WHICH WILL COMBINE WITH DAYTIME HEATING TO YIELD A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON. FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING NEWD ACROSS AREA WILL COMBINE WITH A DEEPENING DRYLINE CIRCULATION TO FOSTER ISOLATED-WIDELY SCATTERED SURFACE-BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY AFTERNOON FROM SWRN TX INTO CNTRL/ERN OK. THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY WILL COMPENSATE FOR MARGINALLY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR TO PROMOTE MULTI- AND SUPERCELL STORM MODES WITH THE PRIMARY HAZARD BEING LARGE HAIL. ..MEAD/LEITMAN.. 05/04/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE SRN PLAINS
sections.text: A FEW CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE OUTLOOK AT 20Z. THE FIRST IS TO REMOVE THE SLIGHT RISK FROM PARTS OF NE AND CNTRL SD WHERE INSTABILITY IS VERY WEAK IN THE WAKE OF CONVECTION MOVING EWD INTO THE SW MN. THE SECOND CHANGE IS TO EXTEND THE 5 PERCENT TORNADO PROBABILITY EWD ACROSS FAR SRN MN AND NRN IA ALONG THE PROJECTED TRACK OF A SUPERCELL CURRENTLY JUST NORTH OF THE MN-IA STATELINE. THE THIRD CHANGE TO THE OUTLOOK IS TO MAKE THE 30 PERCENT WIND DAMAGE PROBABILITY IN SRN IND AND WRN KY SMALLER AND LOCATED JUST AHEAD OF A BOWING LINE-SEGMENT CURRENTLY IN SRN IND. ..BROYLES.. 05/04/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1128 AM CDT FRI MAY 04 2012/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN AREAL COVERAGE ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG WINDS AND HAIL ARE POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY AND A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE WARRANTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REMNANTS OF OVERNIGHT MCS ACTIVITY HAVE PROGRESSED ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY LATE THIS MORNING WITH SEVERAL NOTABLE STRONG UPDRAFTS AFFILIATED IN PROXIMITY TO A DECAYING MCV OVER SWRN IL. SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTIVE DEBRIS/OUTFLOW HAS SPREAD ACROSS MUCH OF CNTRL IL/IND BUT THE AIRMASS ALONG THE OH RIVER IS BEGINNING TO DESTABILIZE SUBSTANTIALLY DUE TO PRONOUNCED HEATING THROUGH PARTIAL SUNSHINE. LATEST DATA SUGGESTS A BELT OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW EXTENDS ACROSS MO ALONG THE OH RIVER WHICH SHOULD ENCOURAGE MULTI-CELL STORM GROWTH/ORGANIZATION AS UPDRAFTS MATURE. LATEST THINKING IS STRONG THUNDERSTORMS OVER SWRN IL WILL GRADUALLY INCREASE AS THEY PROPAGATE ESEWD TOWARD NWRN KY AND OTHER STORMS SHOULD DEVELOP DOWNSTREAM OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS ALONG THE SRN FRINGE OF OLD CONVECTION/OUTFLOW. STRONG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS WITH THESE STORMS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS. MAINLY UNORGANIZED CLUSTERS OR PULSE-TYPE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG-TO-SEVERE WIND GUSTS. AREA WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WERE DEVELOPING EARLY THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE NRN CHESAPEAKE INTO CNTRL PA AND NERN OH IN A WARM...MOIST AIR MASS AHEAD OF A SFC COLD FRONT. THIS COLD FRONT WAS POSITIONED FROM S-CNTRL NY WWD ACROSS NRN OH. FURTHER S ACROSS CNTRL PA INTO ERN VA...A SFC TROUGH AND WARM FRONT WAS PROVIDING ADDITIONAL FOCUS FOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. AS TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED THROUGH THE UPPER 70S INTO THE LOW 80S...MLCAPE VALUES ARE APPROACHING 1000 J/KG AND ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE TO NEAR 1500-2000 J/KG BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON. THIS WILL HELP OVERCOME MODEST DEEP LAYER SHEAR OF AROUND 20-30 KT TO SUSTAIN UPDRAFTS. MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 7 C/KM AND COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL SUPPORT MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY WINDS IN MAINLY DISORGANIZED THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON FROM NERN NEB INTO SWRN MN...INCLUDING PARTS OF SERN SD AND NWRN IA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS HAVE BECOME FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS AND A WATCH ISSUANCE WILL BE COORDINATED BETWEEN THE SPC AND THE AFFECTED LOCAL NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE OFFICES SHORTLY. STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES ALONG AN AXIS FROM NERN NEB INTO SWRN MN. THIS AXIS OF HIGHER INSTABILITY WILL PROVE FAVORABLE FOR UPWARD GROWTH OF ONGOING TSTM ACTIVITY AND LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE WITH THIS CONVECTION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP ALONG THE DRYLINE FROM SWRN OK...ARCING INTO SWRN TX OVER THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS. LARGE HAIL AND STRONG-GUSTY WINDS ARE POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST WV IMAGERY DEPICTS AN EJECTING UPPER VORT OVER SWRN OK AND EARLIER MID LEVEL CONVECTION/DEBRIS HAS GRADUALLY DISSIPATED INVOF THIS FEATURE. AS A RESULT...STRONG LOW LEVEL HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO A DEEPENING BOUNDARY LAYER ALONG THE DRYLINE FROM SWRN OK INTO SWRN TX. IT APPEARS CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES HAVE BEEN BREACHED ALONG THIS ZONE PER RECENT CU DEVELOPMENT AS READINGS HAVE SOARED INTO THE UPPER 90S. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST DRYLINE CONVECTION WILL HAVE BASES ABOVE 700MB WITH SBCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1500-2000 J/KG. WITH A POCKET OF COLD MID LEVEL TEMPERATURES...H5 OF MINUS 12-14C...IT WOULD SEEM LIKELY THAT ANY HIGH BASED THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD PRODUCE HAIL IN ADDITION TO POTENTIALLY DAMAGING DOWNBURSTS. IN THE ABSENCE OF STRONG LARGE SCALE SUPPORT STORMS SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED AS THEY DRIFT EAST AT ROUGHLY 10-15KT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: FAST-MOVING BOW ECHO WILL RACE ACROSS SRN IND INTO THE LOUISVILLE KY METRO AREA. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL DEFINED BOW ECHO...CURRENTLY LOCATED FROM ORANGE/CRAWFORD COUNTIES IN SRN IND...IS BEGINNING TO SURGE ESEWD AT ROUGHLY 45KT. THIS COMPACT CLUSTER OF STORMS WILL SOON MOVE INTO THE LOUISVILLE KY METRO AREA WITH A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. OTHER ISOLATED STORMS ARE ATTEMPTING TO FORM AHEAD OF THIS BOW OVER SERN IND BUT THE PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT IN THE SHORT TERM WILL BE WITH THE SURGING BOW ECHO. ..DARROW.. 05/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE ALONG A CORRIDOR FROM SCNTRL MN...SWWD INTO NERN NEB INTO THE EARLY EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION HAS REJUVENATED ALONG SRN FLANK OF LONGER-LIVED MCS AS IT TRACKS ACROSS THE UPPER MS VALLEY REGION. ALTHOUGH SOMEWHAT COMPLEX...A FEW SUPERCELLS HAVE EVOLVED ALONG A WEAK BOUNDARY THAT STRETCHES FROM THE MN/IA BORDER...SWWD INTO EXTREME NERN NEB. GIVEN THE AXIS OF INSTABILITY THAT EXISTS ALONG THIS CORRIDOR IT APPEARS THE ONGOING CONVECTION WILL MAINTAIN ITS INTENSITY AS IT MOVES ACROSS CNTRL PORTIONS OF WW239. WHILE A FEW OF THE SUPERCELLS ALONG THE MN/IA BORDER HAVE PRODUCED ISOLATED TORNADOES...LATEST THINKING IS THE COMPLEX STORM INTERACTIONS AND THE PROPENSITY FOR UPWARD LINEAR EVOLUTION WILL LIMIT FUTURE TORNADIC POTENTIAL. ..DARROW.. 05/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE INCREASING IN COVERAGE ALONG THE DRYLINE. THESE STORMS ARE SLOWLY PROGRESSING EWD AT ABOUT 15 KTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SRN EDGE OF AN UPPER WAVE NOTED ON 22Z WV IMAGERY FROM SERN KS...CNTRL OK INTO N CNTRL TX HAS LIKELY PROVIDED SUBTLE FORCING FOR ASCENT...ALLOWING SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS TO DEVELOP ALONG THE DRYLINE. AMPLE SURFACE HEATING HAS CONTRIBUTED TO TEMPERATURES NEAR 100 SURROUNDING THE DRYLINE...WHICH HAS BEEN MORE THAN SUFFICIENT TO ERODE ANY REMAINING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. AS SUCH...STORMS HAVE GRADUALLY BEEN INCREASING IN COVERAGE. DESPITE THE SLOW FORWARD MOTION /MEASURED AT ABOUT 15 KTS/...THESE AREAS OF CONVECTION WILL GRADUALLY PROGRESS INTO A MORE UNSTABLE AIR MASS...POSSIBLY SUPPORTING SEMI-ORGANIZED CLUSTERS AND SMALL BOWING SEGMENTS GIVEN MODEST FLOW ALOFT...SHOULD A FEW ORGANIZED COLD POOLS DEVELOP. HOWEVER...THESE THUNDERSTORMS WILL ALSO BE PROGRESSING AWAY FROM MORE FAVORABLE SURFACE CONVERGENCE...WHICH MAY LEAD TO A WEAKENING OF A FEW STORMS AS WELL. A FEW HI-RES MODELS INDICATE POTENTIAL DEVELOPMENT INVOF AN AREA OF CU EXTENDING FROM NEAR ACT NWWD TO MWL. HOWEVER...SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW LITTLE CONFLUENCE/CONVERGENCE THAT MAY FOSTER GREATER UPWARD GROWTH...SO CONFIDENCE IN THIS ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT REMAINS LOW. ..HURLBUT.. 05/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SVR TSTM WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED FOR PARTS OF CENTRAL AND ERN IA AS A DEVELOPING BOW ECHO OVER NRN IA TRACKS SEWD THROUGH THE EVENING PRODUCING A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS. FARTHER W OVER NEB...TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG A TRAILING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AS IT MOVES SWD. THUS...A NEW WW WILL BE NEEDED OVER PARTS OF ERN AND CENTRAL NEB AS WELL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2220Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A DEVELOPING FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS OVER NORTH CENTRAL IA...WITH THE NRN EXTENT LOCATED OVER SRN MN. LATE AFTERNOON SURFACE AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOWED A BOUNDARY AND CONCURRENT INSTABILITY GRADIENT EXTENDING FROM THE DEVELOPING BOW INTO EAST CENTRAL IA AND WRN/CENTRAL IL. CURRENT THINKING AND MODEL DATA SUGGEST THIS BOW WILL TRACK SEWD ALONG THE AFOREMENTIONED GRADIENT...WHILE THE DEVELOPING COLD POOL AIDS IN THE FORWARD PROPAGATION AS WELL. FARTHER W OVER NEB...A MODERATELY-STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT SUGGESTS ADDITIONAL STORMS DEVELOPING IN THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL POSE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A NEW WW WILL BE NEEDED OVER ERN AND CENTRAL NEB AS THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY MOVES SWD INTO THE FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC AND KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT. ..PETERS.. 05/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ACROSS CENTRAL INTO SRN OH...CENTRAL IND...AND NERN KY...WITH THE OH/KY ACTIVITY POTENTIALLY CONSOLIDATING INTO A CLUSTER OF TSTMS MOVING SWD INTO ERN KY/WV. WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND THE ONSET OF COOLING SURFACE TEMPERATURES DUE TO THE LOSS OF DAY TIME HEATING SUGGESTS THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT SHOULD BE SHORT-LIVED. MEANWHILE... TSTMS OVER CENTRAL IND SHOULD ALSO HAVE A SHORT LIFESPAN AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY EVENING SURFACE ANALYSIS COMBINED WITH REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED TSTMS CONTINUED TO DEVELOP ALONG SEVERAL BOUNDARIES. ONE WAS LOCATED GENERALLY E-W ACROSS NRN OH /30 S YNG-20 S MFD-40 E FWA THEN INTO FAR NERN IND AND FAR SWRN LOWER MI. THE SECOND BOUNDARY WAS ORIENTED N-S FROM NWRN OH INTO NERN KY. ALL OF THE 15Z SREF MEMBERS AND THE OPERATIONAL DETERMINISTIC MODELS SUGGESTED THE OH/KY ACTIVITY SHOULD CONSOLIDATE INTO A SWD MOVING CLUSTER OF STORMS THROUGH THE EVENING. GIVEN WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR ACROSS MUCH OF OH AND GRADUAL BOUNDARY LAYER STABILIZATION WITH THE LOSS OF DAY TIME HEATING...THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE LOW AND CURRENTLY DOES NOT WARRANT THE ISSUANCE OF A WW. MEANWHILE ACROSS CENTRAL IND...AN APPARENT MCV PER SATELLITE IMAGERY WITH SOME SURFACE REFLECTION WILL ADVANCE EWD ACROSS CENTRAL IND THIS EVENING. ASCENT WITH THIS FEATURE MAY AID ADDITIONAL SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS...BUT WEAKENING INSTABILITY AND WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR SUGGEST THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD TEND TO BE SHORT-LIVED AND LARGELY SUB-SEVERE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO SLOWLY PROGRESS ESEWD INTO S CNTRL OK AND CNTRL TX. SEVERAL COUNTIES HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE WW NEAR THE DFW METRO...AND MORE MAY BE NEEDED TO THE S AND SW LATER THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DRYLINE STORMS CONTINUE TO SLOWLY PROGRESS ESEWD AT ABOUT 15 KTS...WITH TWO PRIMARY AREAS EMERGING. THE FIRST IS A SUPERCELL NEAR THE OK/TX BORDER THAT HAS HAD A HISTORY OF PRODUCING SIGNIFICANT HAIL. THE SECOND AREA IS A CLUSTER OF MULTICELLS AND SUPERCELLS...PROGRESSING TOWARDS GREATER INSTABILITY. 00Z FWD SOUNDING IS SHOWING AN EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS...WITH VEERING LOW LEVEL WINDS AND MODEST WLYS ALOFT CONTRIBUTING TO ROTATING UPDRAFTS. GENERALLY WEAK LOW LEVEL WINDS WOULD SUGGEST THAT ANY TORNADO THAT CAN DEVELOP WILL BE BRIEF...AND THAT A PREDOMINANT THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS WILL CONTINUE. ..HURLBUT.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PARTS OF SRN IL...INTO SWRN IND...NWRN KY AND POSSIBLY EAST CENTRAL MO MAY NEED A WW ISSUANCE THIS EVENING. MODELS SUGGEST NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD OCCUR OVER SRN IL INTO SWRN IND/NWRN KY AND NWWD TO POTENTIALLY EAST CENTRAL MO. IF THESE TRENDS ARE CONFIRMED BY RADAR TRENDS...THEN A WW WOULD LIKELY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A STORM WITH A ROBUST UPDRAFT FORMED OVER WAYNE COUNTY IL WITH A COUPLE OF ADDITIONAL STORMS NWD TO EFFINGHAM COUNTY IL. THIS ACTIVITY DEVELOPED WITHIN AN INCREASING WAA REGIME IN THE NOSE OF A STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO THE MID MS/LOWER OH VALLEY...AND INVOF A SE-NW ORIENTED BOUNDARY WHICH EXTENDED FROM FAR SWRN IND THROUGH WAYNE COUNTY IL TO WEST CENTRAL IL. A RESIDUAL MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /7.5-8 C PER KM/ COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-45 KT PER A 40-50 KT NWLY MIDLEVEL JET EXTENDING FROM SRN IL TO WRN/SRN KY IS SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORMS WITH LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE WAA AND WITHIN THE ENTRANCE REGION OF THE AFOREMENTIONED MIDLEVEL JET SUGGEST NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THE LLJ IS MAINTAINED INTO THE SRN IL REGION THROUGH THE EVENING. MOST OF THE 15Z SREF MEMBERS AND THE OPERATIONAL DETERMINISTIC MODELS SUGGEST CONVECTION WILL BE LIKELY INVOF THE CURRENT STORMS AND BOTH SEWD AND NWWD ALONG THE WARM FRONT THROUGH THIS EVENING INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT PERIOD. ACTIVITY SHOULD TEND TO TRACK SEWD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SMALL BOW ECHO MOVING EWD AT 30 KT ACROSS FAR NERN IA MAY POSE A LIMITED THREAT FOR A STRONG WIND GUST OR TWO. HOWEVER... OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE WANING...WITH POTENTIAL FOR WW 242 TO BE CANCELLED WELL BEFORE THE SCHEDULED 05Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0125Z...REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A SMALL BOWING LINE SEGMENT LOCATED OVER NERN IA /ERN WINNESHIEK COUNTY TO BREMER COUNTY/. THIS ACTIVITY HAS SLOWED ITS EWD MOVEMENT TO 30 KT. THIS SLOWER SPEED COMBINED WITH A STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER SUGGESTS THE OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO WANE AND NOT WARRANT THE ISSUANCE OF ADDITIONAL DOWNSTREAM WATCHES. ..PETERS.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL ARE GRADUALLY DIMINISHING IN COVERAGE. THE WW WILL BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z...THOUGH ISOLATED SEVERE MAY STILL OCCUR OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO BE INSUFFICIENT TO WARRANT A NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE WRN PORTION OF THE WW CONTINUES TO STABILIZE IN THE WAKE OF CONVECTIVE PRECIPITATION...AND AS DIURNAL COOLING BEGINS. DOWNSTREAM OF THE ONGOING CONVECTION...MODERATE INSTABILITY IS PERSISTING...WITH A NOW CLEARLY EVIDENT /PARTIALLY CONVECTIVELY INDUCED/ VORT MAX SEEMING TO MAINTAIN A CLUSTER OF STORMS OVER N CNTRL TX. WITH OUTFLOW UNDERCUTTING THE STORMS AND SURGING WELL OUT AHEAD...AND THE ONSET OF DIURNAL COOLING...EXPECT A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..HURLBUT.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SVR WEATHER THREAT THROUGH THE REST OF THE EVENING IS EXPECTED TO BE CONFINED TO CENTRAL NEB AND POTENTIALLY INTO PARTS OF NERN AND EAST CENTRAL NEB TO THE W OF THE NEB/IA BORDER. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS. FARTHER E ALONG AND E OF THE NEB/IA BORDER...A CONVECTIVELY STABILIZED AIR MASS SUGGESTS THE ERN EXTENT OF WW 241 COULD BE CANCELLED EARLY. THE REST OF WW 241 SHOULD BE MAINTAINED THROUGH 05Z AND THE WRN EXTENT OF WW 239 IN CENTRAL NEB HAS BEEN TEMPORALLY EXTENDED UNTIL 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS AND TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THE TRAILING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ATTENDANT TO THE MCS THAT MOVED EWD ACROSS NRN-NERN IA AND ADJACENT SRN-SERN MN EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL IA /30 N DSM/ SWWD TO 25 SSE OLU...THEN WWD TO JUST S OF LBF...AND NWWD TO WEST CENTRAL NEB. STREAMLINE ANALYSES OF 850 MB FLOW PER WIND PROFILERS AND WSR-88D VWP DATA INDICATED A SLY LLJ EXTENDING FROM CENTRAL KS INTO SOUTH CENTRAL NEB WHICH SHOULD SUSTAIN ONGOING CENTRAL NEB CONVECTIVE COMPLEX LOCATED JUST N OF THE E-W OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE LLJ INTO THIS REGION WILL PROMOTE ISENTROPIC ASCENT AND STRENGTHENING WAA ACROSS THE ACTIVE PORTION OF WW 241/239...WITH ELEVATED CONVECTION EXTENDING EVEN INTO NERN NEB AND NWRN IA. RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY ACROSS THIS REGION COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH THE SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. MEANWHILE...THE SAME 850 MB STREAMLINE ANALYSIS INDICATED DIFFLUENT FLOW OVER NERN KS WHICH SHOULD CONTINUE TO LIMIT LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND ANY NEW CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IN THE SHORT TERM INTO SERN NEB AND FAR SWRN IA. ..PETERS.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS WILL INCREASE GRADUALLY THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS ERN MO AND SWRN IL...WHERE A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WAA IS SLOWLY STRENGTHENING IN CONJUNCTION WITH A 30-35 KT SWLY LLJ ACROSS MO...WITH THE WAA FOCUSED ALONG A STALLED FRONT. A FEED OF MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY REMAINS IMMEDIATELY UPSTREAM OF THIS BOUNDARY...WHICH SUGGESTS THAT STORM COVERAGE WILL LIKELY INCREASE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ADDITIONALLY...STORM COVERAGE COULD BE AIDED OVERNIGHT BY THE APPROACH OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH FROM SW MO/NW AR. STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MUCAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...IN AN ENVIRONMENT WITH SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND SOME TRANSIENT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. DAMAGING WINDS COULD ALSO BECOME A CONCERN ONCE STORM COVERAGE INCREASES AND CELL MERGERS PROMOTE SOME UPSCALE GROWTH OF CONVECTION. THE ERN MO/SWRN IL AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...AND THE SEVERE STORM RISK COULD BECOME SUFFICIENT TO WARRANT A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH. ..THOMPSON.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW WW WILL COORDINATED SOON TO REPLACE WW 241 AND THE ONGOING SVR THREAT ACROSS A PART OF THE LOCALLY EXTENDED PORTION OF WW 239.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG TO SVR TSTMS CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ACROSS CENTRAL AND NERN-ERN NEB...WITHIN A WAA REGIME N OF AN OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT EXTENDED GENERALLY E-W FROM EAST CENTRAL TO CENTRAL NEB. RESIDUAL MODERATE INSTABILITY AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT ARE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT TO SUSTAIN STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS INTO THE EARLY OVERNIGHT PERIOD. ..PETERS.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS SHOULD PERSIST OVER MUCH OF THE AREA...WITH A THREAT OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND MARGINAL HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STORMS WERE ONGOING FROM SRN IL INTO CNTRL KY. OUTFLOW FROM THE CNTRL/ERN KY STORMS CURRENTLY TRAILS WWD ALONG OR JUST N OF THE OH RIVER AND ACROSS SWRN IND. AMPLE MOISTURE AND INSTABILITY EXIST S OF THE BOUNDARY AND WSWLY LOW LEVEL FLOW WILL MAINTAIN A FAVORABLE FLUX INTO THE DEVELOPING STORMS. INDICATIONS ARE THAT THE IL STORMS MAY PERSIST SEWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY WITH A WIND THREAT. THIS ENTIRE AREA IS BEING HELPED ALONG BY WEAK MIDLEVEL SPEED MAX WITH 30-35 KT FLOW HELPING TO PUSH STORMS ALONG AND CREATE ENOUGH DEEP SHEAR FOR FORWARD PROPAGATION. HIGH PWAT ENVIRONMENT WILL FURTHER OUTFLOW PRODUCTION. ..JEWELL.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ELEVATED HAIL STORMS ARE DEVELOPING AND WILL LIKELY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE FORMED RAPIDLY OVER NERN WY AND WRN SD AS COOLING WITH THE UPPER TROUGH OVERSPREADS AN INCREASINGLY MOIST AIR MASS ABOVE A SURFACE STABLE LAYER. MUCH OF THE MOISTENING IS AROUND 700 MB WHERE FLOW IS OUT OF THE S. FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE 2-3 KM OF A WEAK LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES BUT STEEP LAPSE RATES ABOVE. VERY STRONG DEEP LAYER EFFECTIVE SHEAR WILL PROVE FAVORABLE FOR HAIL STORMS. ..JEWELL.. 05/05/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LINE OF STORMS WILL LIKELY PERSIST FOR A WHILE LONGER...BUT IT APPEARS THAT SEVERITY MAY DECREASE GRADUALLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STORMS CONTINUED TO DROP SWD THROUGH WW 245 AND NOW ENTERING NRN MIDDLE TN. ERN PORTIONS OF THE LINE HAVE BEEN THE MOST IMPRESSIVE ON RADAR WITH CONVECTION KEEPING UP WITH THE GUST FRONT. HOWEVER...LATEST TRENDS INDICATE THE GUST FRONT SURGING FARTHER AWAY FROM THE PARENT STORMS. IF THIS TREND CONTINUES...THEN A GENERAL WEAKENING IS EXPECTED. CONDITIONS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED...BUT IT IS NOT CLEAR THAT ANOTHER WATCH WILL BE NEEDED OVER ERN TN AS STORMS INTERACT WITH LESSER INSTABILITY AND COOLER BOUNDARY LAYER TEMPERATURES. ..JEWELL.. 05/05/2012
